gloss: to empty; to make room; to vacate

definitions.gloss: to empty; to make room; to clear out
definitions.explanation: To remove the contents of something, making it empty or creating space.
To leave a position, seat, or place unoccupied. Also used for making time available.

examples.japanese: ⟦バケツ→バケツ：11118_baketsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{空|あ}ける。
⟦{引|ひ}き{出|だ}し→引き出し：01498_hikidashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{空|あ}け→空く：11062_aku⟧て⟦スペース→スペース：11049_supeesu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I emptied the drawer to make space.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{午後|ごご}→午後：00544_gogo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{空|あ}け→空く：11062_aku⟧ておく。

notes:
Written with {空|あ} (empty) to distinguish from the other あける verbs.

THREE あける VERBS:
- {空|あ}ける: to empty, to vacate (this entry)
- ⟦{開|あ}ける→開ける：00563_akeru⟧: to open (a door, lid, etc.)
- ⟦{明|あ}ける→明ける：21288_akeru⟧: to dawn, for a period to end

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- Pair: ⟦{空|あ}く→空く：11062_aku⟧ (intransitive — to become empty/available)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{空|あ}ける: to vacate a seat
- ⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{空|あ}ける: to be away from home
- ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{空|あ}ける: to make time available
- ⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{空|あ}ける: to clear a space
- ⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{空|あ}け→空く：11062_aku⟧ておく: to keep one's schedule open
